gates.name: STAGE2_ENTRY_PROVEN
gates.acceptance: The exact Stage 2 external closure and protected authorities are independently reproduced.

gates.name: ACTIVE_CONTRACT_SET_PROVEN
gates.acceptance: Only the unchanged digest-bound active v2 registry is accepted with complete offline schema resolution.

gates.name: CANONICAL_INPUT_PROVEN
gates.acceptance: Strict parsing, normalization, canonical bytes, framing, counts, sizes, and digests fail closed.

gates.name: BUNDLE_BINDING_PROVEN
gates.acceptance: Policy, manifest, locators, and source bytes form one complete confined admission bundle.

gates.name: IDENTITY_REPLAY_ATOMICITY_PROVEN
gates.acceptance: Source identity, replay, conflicts, and all-or-nothing candidate state match frozen semantics.

gates.name: FINANCIAL_ADMISSION_PROVEN
gates.acceptance: Checked money and journal balance checks reject invalid financial input before reconciliation.

gates.name: NORMALIZATION_AND_ROUTING_PROVEN
gates.acceptance: Keys, currencies, bank references, and ambiguity controls produce deterministic reconciliation-ready records.

gates.name: CLAIM_BOUNDARY_PROVEN
gates.acceptance: Admission is deterministic and side-effect-free and emits no proof, case, revision, Spark, persistence, network, or AWS result.

gates.name: REPRODUCIBLE_CANDIDATE_PROVEN
gates.acceptance: Two clean exact-toolchain runs agree, all coverage and mutation gates pass, and external closure remains fail-closed.
